reference_repair.finding: Historical Julia computes mathematically equivalent histogram/padding/scatter through a host prefix-scan roundtrip instead of native small/general GPU paths. Its expert_ids zero-fill and thread0 expert-label stores can overlap across warps, a source-observed potential race, not a measured historical failure. Named reference preserves original bytes, restores actual source small/general algorithm structure, uses explicit portable Blelloch scan instead of CUB, and keeps fill threads alive through barriers. These are P1 mapping/control-flow adaptations with output-equivalent intent.
